description.value:
Some things in Night City come ridiculously cheap – a bottle of booze, human life or the Umbra from Darra Polytechnic. Now, some might claim this India-manufactured Power AR is an unwieldy hunk of low-grade alloy that wouldn't last five minutes in a real Friday Night Firefight. Those people would be right. Despite its drawbacks, the Umbra is growing in popularity – you can empty a few clips into a choom, then toss it in the sewer without a second thought.

Cost: 150eb (Costly)

Class: Poor Quality Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 40 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Has 1 less Attachment Slot (2 Total). Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Basic Ammunition. When this weapon jams, it requires 2 Actions to clear the jam before it can be fired again.

Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
